notes:
BLOCKING, read first: this manifest cannot launch as written. hook.contract names PaperHook, the V1 implementation that declares getHookPermissions and whose only constructor argument is IPoolManager. Its constructor disables initialization, so a bare PaperHook at a mined address has no manager, token or owner in storage: every callback reverts Unauthorized and PoolManager.initialize fails (reproduced locally). The working hook is PaperProxy(implementation, initialization), a TransparentUpgradeableProxy CREATE2-mined so address & 0x3fff == 0x3fff, whose constructor delegatecalls initialize($token, hookOwner, imdUsdWad). This schema cannot express the implementation-then-proxy sequence, the initializer inputs or the hook owner, and the protected runtime scan rejects DELEGATECALL, which every proxy executes. PaperHook is named because it is the only delivered contract with an IPoolManager constructor argument and the permission declaration. Deployed bare, it passes the protected checks locally, but that verifies the implementation, not the proxy the pool would call. Launch needs deployer support for PaperDeployment.deployHook (atomic proxy deployment plus pool initialization) and a proxy admission exception, or a non-proxy redesign.

Permissions: getHookPermissions returns all 14 flags true in PaperHook and PaperHookV2, as the brief requires. beforeInitialize binds one sorted paper/IMD pool, accepts LP fee 500, 3000 or 10000 with positive tick spacing, records the launch price, and allows initialization only by the recorded launcher or hook owner. Every callback requires PoolManager as caller; unused callbacks validate the pool and return their selector with zero deltas. Paper has no constructor arguments and 18 decimals.

Pool: paper/IMD on Ethereum mainnet, LP fee 3000 and tick spacing 60 (the brief names no other tier). initialPrice is 2^96, raw currency1/currency0 = 1. IMD reports 18 decimals on mainnet, so this is 1 paper = 1 IMD. It is the only price that does not depend on the paper/IMD sort order, which is unknown until the token address exists. It is an assumption, not a reviewed launch price.

Fee: a constant 200 bps of the IMD leg in both directions via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, separate from the LP fee. Defaults are 50 bps to orders 0x721F8232e19c92516eB753FEF53d8A33a3637989 and 150 bps to dev 0xb59eac9882Ba98f4170d99D5F402C3EDb6D50D75. Owner-only setSplit requires the parts to sum to 200. Fees are paid with PoolManager.take in the same swap; nothing accumulates and no claims are minted, so a swap reverts with InsufficientFeeBacking when the manager holds less IMD than the fee. A paper-only pool therefore needs the input-prepaying PaperSwapRouter, or prior IMD backing, for first buys. Partially filled IMD-specified swaps revert.

Upgradeability: the ProxyAdmin owner is the constant dev address, not a constructor argument. State uses one ERC-7201 namespace. PaperProxy pins the runtime hashes of the delivered PaperHook and PaperHookV2 with the same manager, so no other implementation can be installed. PaperHookV2 reverses the default split to 150/50 for fresh proxies only; an upgrade keeps existing state and split.

Voting: postFeeUsd starts at 1 whole USD. postFeeTokens uses the pool sqrtPriceX96 and owner-set imdUsd (1e18 scale); no chain-readable USD source is configured. With zero active liquidity it uses the launch price or the last post-swap price seen with liquidity. postDraft(bytes32) is uncapped; postDraft(bytes32,uint256) reverts above the caller's maximum. postDraft and burn send paper to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD and emit DraftPosted/Burned. Rounds, quorum and winners are not stored. The spot price is manipulable.

Evidence: 196 local tests pass (unit, fuzz, upgrade, invariant). No mainnet fork rehearsal or independent admission has run.
